atlas_n_mission.challenge: what does cc_bindings_from_rs's main reach to generate C++ bindings from a Rust crate -- which crubit library functions does it call?
atlas_n_mission.answer: E12: nothing -- main has 6 unresolved call sites, the closure passed to and_then 1 (run_with_cmdline_args), depends_on empty, and neither explain nor unknowns says why; the census obligation alone records that no Cargo target's module tree reaches the file

differential.oracle: the source at the pin (ORACLE_READ, recorded) and Cargo's documented target-path rule (a target path is relative to its manifest's directory); crubit is a bindings generator, not a code-intelligence tool, so the comparison is Atlas against ground truth

findings.question: what does main in cc_bindings_from_rs/cc_bindings_from_rs.rs call?
findings.ground_truth: Cmdline::new (cc_bindings_from_rs/cmdline.rs:211, crate cc_bindings_from_rs_cmdline, extern name cmdline); inside the closure at 26:18, cpp_api_from_rust_lib::run_with_cmdline_args (cc_bindings_from_rs/lib.rs:307); the rest are std, itertools and clap methods
findings.atlas_n_plus_1: main -> cmdline.rs::new; closure@26:18 -> lib.rs::run_with_cmdline_args; the method calls on std/clap values stay unresolved
findings.classification_n: ATLAS defect, sound but silent: nothing false was claimed, but the file was never evaluated because its crate root was never found, and no lens said so (fixed in E13)

findings.question: do crubit's crates have roots Atlas can reach?
findings.ground_truth: 174 crate targets; 50 declare a path climbing out of their manifest's directory (cargo/**/Cargo.toml -> ../../../<source>.rs), all 50 existing once normalized
findings.atlas_n: the 50 climbing targets produced crate roots that matched no inventory path: their module trees were never evaluated

findings.question: which resources does crubit acquire and release across the FFI boundary?
findings.ground_truth: the Rust binaries call C++ entry points (crubit_rs_bindings_from_cc_main, rs_bindings_from_cc.rs:22 -> rs_bindings_from_cc.cc:116); common/token_stream_printer.rs spawns a child process and a writer thread (545) joined at 553
findings.atlas_n: no resource; 1 FFI declaration with a caller
findings.atlas_n_plus_1: the thread spawn and its JOIN release (DERIVED, correct); 2 FFI declarations with callers, the C++ definitions UNKNOWN; the child process is not a resource
findings.classification_n_plus_1: ATLAS_CORRECT for the thread; OUT_OF_SCOPE for the C++ side (no C/C++ frontend, DEBT-MULTILANGUAGE) and the child process (process handles are outside the std-path resource table)

implementation.mechanism_vs_implementation: nothing of crubit is absorbed: its Bazel and Cargo trees, bindings generators and golden tests are studied only; the donor exposed an Atlas defect -- crate roots of manifests whose targets lie outside their directory were never found
implementation.change: runtime census::resolution: target_path resolves a manifest target against its directory with . and .. collapsed, refusing a path above the repository root; crate_targets uses it for the library, binaries, build script and Cargo's defaults (ADR 0079)
implementation.falsification: 5 mutants killed (the escape refusal dropped twice, the . segment kept, the library and the binaries joined unnormalized); a synthetic fixture carries the climbing library, binary, renamed path dependency and the escaping target
